policy: When an unsuffixed digital identity maps to several pre-game physical print generations, keep the character family verified and preserve color, printing, mold, or component-generation differences for visual comparison. Later post-game redesigns are excluded from source-equivalence, while catalog aliases are retained rather than treated as separate characters.

plausible_pre_game_physical_candidates.catalog_name: Barriss Offee, Black Hood and Cape
Barriss Offee, Dark Blue Hood and Cape
Barriss Offee, Dark Blue Hood and Cape, Skirt

records.reason: All supported Barriss Offee releases predate the game but differ in hood color and skirt/body treatment. The unsuffixed digital key establishes the character, not which decoration generation was used, so exact physical release remains visual pending.

Both supported Nute Gunray releases predate the game and differ principally in robe-color/design generation. The source key has no robe qualifier, so the character family is verified while exact release remains visual pending.

The 2008/2010 white-undershirt and 2014 dark-tan-undershirt releases are both valid pre-game Plo Koon generations. The unsuffixed key does not distinguish them, while the 2025 printed-leg redesign postdates the game and cannot establish source equivalence.

plausible_pre_game_physical_candidates.catalog_name: Captain Antilles, Dark Tan Undershirt, Single Sided Head

rejected_post_game_candidate.catalog_name: Captain Antilles, Dark Tan Undershirt, Dual Sided Head

records.reason: Two materially different Captain Antilles physical generations predate the game: the 2009 light-gray-undershirt figure and the 2019 dark-tan-undershirt single-sided-head revision. The 2024 dual-sided-head revision postdates the corpus. Exact pre-game generation remains visual pending.

plausible_pre_game_physical_candidates.catalog_name: Astromech Droid, R5-D4, Short Stripes, 30361a Body
Astromech Droid, R5-D4, Short Stripes, 30361c Body
Astromech Droid, R5-D4, Long Stripes, 30361c Body

records.reason: R5-D4 has several pre-game physical implementations spanning body mold, dome printing, stripe length, and a catalog alias that also names R5-D8. Those are component-generation differences rather than evidence for distinct digital characters in this record. Exact physical implementation requires visual/component comparison.

systemic_findings: Catalog aliases such as R5-D8 / R5-D4 should be preserved as alias evidence rather than split into separate source identities without additional proof.
Mold revisions, undershirt colors, robe colors, hood colors, and stripe/body changes are component-generation evidence and require visual comparison when the source key is unqualified.
Later redesigns can be excluded by release date without resolving which of several earlier physical generations supplied the game artwork.
